milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the cobblestone stairs and face toward them to demonstrate they have found them. The stairs are a 4-block-wide row at spawn-relative (5-8, 0, 2) at the entrance of a stone brick building. Target is set to the center of the row at [7, 0, 2]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the stairs rather than facing away.
